description: After serving two terms on the San Diego Board of Education and four representing California’s 79th Assembly District, Weber is now the third most powerful person in the state. She spoke with the Cut about why she had to be recruited to run for office, her greatest professional heartbreak, and how she’s opening the door for the next generation of Black women leaders.
title: [The Cut] Imagine If We Took Personal Ambition Out of Politics - Shirley Weber for Secretary of State
